nodes.body: **Mutation failures report success** If an authenticated `gh` session lacks write access to `-Repo`, targets the wrong host or account, or encounters an API failure, these disposition commands suppress the errors and do not check their exit status. The script then prints “Label taxonomy sync complete” and exits successfully, so an operator may believe the batch converged even though some or all six labels remain absent or stale. Check each mutation and return a nonzero status when synchronization fails.

**Assert the canonical edit names, not only a lower bound.**

A missing canonical edit can pass when a duplicate or other edit keeps the total at 24 or higher. Compare the extracted edit names with `realCanon().labels`; this also enforces the repository’s exact-count contract.

+      const expectedEdited = realCanon().labels.map((label) => label.name).sort();
